s02em.motion:
One continuous handheld shot, wide lens, close and slightly low; the camera holds its place and his feet stay planted. He stabs the pointing finger at the lens twice, each jab stopping dead. He snaps both arms crossed tight over his chest, holds one beat, then flings them straight out sideways at shoulder height. He slaps a flat hand onto his chest, then lunges his face towards the lens and jabs the finger again to finish. Between moves his head juts forward on every accent and his hunched shoulders jerk up with the stresses: lean in, pull back, lean in. Sharp starts, hard stops, never a smooth wave. Sound: rain dripping off concrete, tyres hissing overhead, distant traffic.
Thanks.

s02fc.motion:
One continuous close shot, camera static with a faint handheld drift. Feet stay planted the whole time; all the movement is in his upper body. He sways slowly side to side, loose and lazy, one shoulder rolling forward on each sway. The reaching hand flicks twice from the wrist towards the lens, fingers fanning, then drops back. He leans in close, then settles back with a small late nod. Both hands cross low in front of his stomach, fingers flicking down and out, held a beat, released. He keeps swaying and flicking to the last second. Sound: traffic rumbling overhead, rain dripping into puddles.
Thanks.

s02mm.motion:
One continuous shot, the camera fixed low and close with a wide fisheye lens looking up. His feet stay planted the whole time; all movement comes from his hips, shoulders and arms. He pulls the splayed hand back, then snaps a fist out at the lens, yanks it back, and swats low sideways with the other hand, loose at the wrist. He keeps bouncing down at the knees, head ducking hard toward the lens on every stressed beat, shoulders rolling and hunching, leaning in further over the camera. Near the end the open hand shoots at the lens again. Fast, snapped, never still. Sound: rain dripping off concrete, distant motorway traffic rumbling overhead.
Thanks.

s02kl.motion:
One continuous shot, the camera locked low and close on a wide lens. His feet stay planted on the wet ground; every move comes from the hips, shoulders and arms, fast and staccato, each one stopping dead for a beat. The reaching hand snaps back to his chest. Both gloved hands spread their fingers and stab forward together, then wring and claw in front of his chest. He pitches forward from the waist, jabs a finger at the lens twice, then flicks an open palm out toward the road. Between moves his head cocks sharply side to side and his shoulders jolt up. He keeps moving to the final second. Ambient sound only: rain dripping off concrete, tyres hissing on the road above.
Thanks.

t06ab.motion:
Handheld, slightly low, one continuous medium shot; the camera stays put. Feet stay planted in the sand the whole time. The raised finger jabs the sky twice, then the arm drops and the loose gloved hand rolls at the wrist beside his head, fingers spread, flicking like a man telling a story at dinner. He sways from the hips, shoulders shaking as he laughs, head nodding late and lazy. He leans towards the lens, pats the air palm-down, slaps his hand to his masked forehead in mock disbelief, then flings it out wide, palm up, shrugging. The champagne slops on every move. Sound: surf, palm fronds rustling, distant gulls.
Thanks.

t06rz.motion:
One continuous shot, low and wide at waist height, with a slight handheld sway. His feet stay planted in the sand the whole time; all the motion comes from the knees, hips and shoulders. He rocks his upper body side to side like a pendulum, dropping one shoulder then the other, lurching his masked face right up into the lens and pulling back. On every beat an arm swings loose and wide: a backhand sweep out to the side, an open palm flung down at the lens, then the other arm swinging low across his body. His head cocks and nods hard with each lurch, never pausing, jacket swinging with him to the last second. Sound: surf, wind in the palms, sand crunching underfoot.
Thanks.

t06gf.motion:
Low wide-angle camera, locked off, close on him. He raps hard and choppy, every move snapping out and stopping dead. Feet stay planted in the sand while his hunched torso rocks side to side above them. 0-2 seconds: both flat palms sweep across his belly and flick out. 2-4 seconds: he jabs his thumb back at his own chest three times, shoulders pumping left, right. 4-6 seconds: one flat hand chops sideways at waist height while his head dips and juts at the lens. 6-8 seconds: he leans right into the lens, both hands spread low, still rocking. Ambient sound: surf, wind in palm fronds.
Thanks.

t06rr.motion:
Handheld low-angle camera, one continuous shot, holding close as the man performs with slow, heavy, unhurried authority, feet planted in the sand. He rocks his weight forward into the lens on a hard line, the raised hand pumping towards the camera in a loose fist, then settles back with his chin lifted and both palms spread wide at shoulder height, held for a beat like he owns the beach. His head rolls in big slow nods, shoulders swaying side to side. He presses both gloved hands together at his chest and rubs them slowly, then flicks one finger at the lens. Jacket cloth swings with every move. Sound: surf breaking, palm fronds rustling in the wind.
Thanks.
